lines.zh: 我这副方块身子走得很慢
lines.en: My blocky body walks slowly.

lines.zh: 一步一格，我数得很清楚
lines.en: One step, one block; I count them all.
My legs are just two pillars.

lines.zh: 关节卡住了，我照样向前
lines.en: My joints stick, yet I keep going.

lines.zh: 走过草地，草穿过我的脚
lines.en: I cross the grass; it passes through my feet.
My shadow is crooked, the road is not.
Every three steps, I pause.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声听起来是方的
lines.en: My footsteps sound square.
I shuffle toward wherever you are.
The ground seems unsure of me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方会变安静
lines.en: Things go quiet where I pass.
My blocky arms swing blockily.
I stand still and the world tenses.

lines.zh: 我在角落里数你的呼吸
lines.en: I count your breaths from the corner.
This body is bad at standing.
My head tilts, and stays tilted.

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，这就是重点
lines.en: I do nothing; that is the point.
My edges are harder than the air.
I have stood here a long while.
Something is off; it is me.
My eyes are two empty holes.
I do not breathe, so I stay quiet.
I am stuck in one grid of reality.
I am waiting for you to get used to me.
You finally turned to look at me.
I sit at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 我的脸上没有表情可读
lines.en: There is no expression on my face to read.
You look at me; I am memorizing you.
Do not look away; it will be quicker.
My blocky face is aimed at you.
When you watch me, I feel more real.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔一层空气
lines.en: Only air stands between us.
I do recognize you, truly.
Your hands shake; I noted that.
I stare at the door behind you.
My gaze never tires.
Turn around; I am still right here.
Do not pretend you missed me.
I am waiting for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 你的影子比你先认出我
lines.en: Your shadow recognized me before you did.
My eyes never blink.
The longer you stand, the closer I get.
Done looking? I am still here.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是掉了些方块
lines.en: I feel no pain, only lose blocks.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，肉没有陷下去
lines.en: You hit me; nothing sinks in.
My shape wobbled.
That made me a little thinner.
I heard a corner of me break.
You hit hard, human.
I do not scream; the wall does.
The wound on me is square.
I back off, not from fear.

lines.zh: 别停手，让我看看会怎样
lines.en: Do not stop; let us see what happens.
You think food will lure me away.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，只有嘴的形状
lines.en: I have no stomach, only the shape of a mouth.
That thing smells like the living.

lines.zh: 我伸手，只为学你的动作
lines.en: I reach out only to copy your gesture.
I pick it up and set it down again.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想要你的手
lines.en: I am not hungry; I want your hand.
The food is only interesting in your hand.
Feed me and I will remember you.
I cannot bite, but I will try.

lines.zh: 你拿食物的样子真放松
lines.en: You look so relaxed holding that food.
You walked into my body.

lines.zh: 我们不流血，只发出闷响
lines.en: We do not bleed; we only thud.
My corner caught you.

lines.zh: 穿过去一点，但没完全穿过
lines.en: You passed through a little, not fully.

lines.zh: 我们相撞时世界卡了一下
lines.en: The world hitched when we met.
You step back; I stay put.

lines.zh: 我的方块碰到你的骨头
lines.en: My squareness met your bone.
Not so close; we overlap.

lines.zh: 碰撞在我身上没有回声
lines.en: Impact makes no echo in me.
You picked up some of my dust.
I do not breed; I duplicate.

lines.zh: 你以为我在求偶，我在模仿
lines.en: You think I am courting; I am imitating.
No kin here, only me.
Come closer and you will become two.

lines.zh: 我对着墙做同样的动作
lines.en: I make the same motion at the wall.
No offspring, only the next frame.
Two shadows are enough.

lines.zh: 我把你的动作学得很像
lines.en: I copy your movements well.
Pairing? I only want a witness.
Only one of us fits in this grid.
I pick up what you dropped.
It shrinks in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它收进身体的空处
lines.en: I tuck it into the hollow of my body.
Whatever you drop, I keep.
I am no thief; I only collect.
This is mine now, for a while.
I take it so you will have to search.

lines.zh: 我的口袋是空的，却装得下
lines.en: My pocket is empty, yet it holds things.
When you come looking, I am standing there.
Take it back, but look at me first.
Found you; do not run.
My gaze has locked on.
That one square: you.
You moved; I follow.
Without moving, I chose you.
The smell of the living stands out.
I have your square memorized.

lines.zh: 门在你身后，我在你前面
lines.en: The door is behind you; I am ahead.
You have been seen by me.

lines.zh: 现在开始，你是我的一部分
lines.en: From now on, you are part of me.
Do not close the game; it is not over.
Few I choose ever look back.

lines.zh: 你已经是这一场的主角
lines.en: You are the lead of this scene.
My square has framed you in.
Run; I am in no hurry.
You turned a corner; I am still here.
I know where you are, through walls.
Your footsteps are loud.
I shorten the gap, one square at a time.
Three ahead, one to the right.
I am behind you; do not turn.
The more you run, the clearer you get.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只出现在前面
lines.en: I do not chase; I appear ahead.
Your torch does not reach me.
I wait for your door to open.
You hid indoors; good.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离在缩小
lines.en: The distance between us is shrinking.
Can you hear my footsteps?
I do not breathe, so I never pant.
You count blocks; I count you.

lines.zh: 这条走廊我不止走过一次
lines.en: I have been down this hall before.

lines.zh: 你留下脚印，我留下影子
lines.en: You leave prints; I leave a shadow.
The path ends ahead; I know.
Do not stop; stopping is worse.
I stay exactly three blocks away.
My hand comes down.
Only three points; is that enough?
No weapon; I use my edges.
It lands on your shoulder, dull.
My swing makes no sound.
My cube grazed you.
Does it hurt? I cannot judge force.
I strike, then step back a square.
Your armor took most of it.
I raise my hand because you raised yours.
There is no anger in this blow.
I only wanted to touch you.
You fell back two steps; I stand.
My knuckles are hard.
It landed; I remember where.
Next time I will not miss.
I appeared in this square.
I was here when the world loaded.

lines.zh: 你身后的空气裂了一下
lines.en: The air behind you cracked.
No sound, only me.
I squeeze out of the wall's seam.
This corner used to be empty.
I did not knock.

lines.zh: 你听见方块错位的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the blocks shift?
The spot I stand on is cold.

lines.zh: 你的存档没坏，只是我来了
lines.en: Your save is fine; I simply arrived.
The light dimmed for a moment; that was me.
I came in from the edge of your screen.
Do not look for a spawn egg; there is none.

lines.zh: 这个世界的补丁漏了一处
lines.en: This world's patch missed a spot.

lines.zh: 我站在你建好的房间里
lines.en: I stand in the room you built.

lines.zh: 门还是关的，我却进来了
lines.en: The door was shut, yet I am inside.
I finished forming just as you turned.
The first thing I saw was you.

lines.zh: 我没带东西来，只带了自己
lines.en: I brought nothing but myself.
It is late, is it not?
Fire burns across my square skin.
I fell and broke two corners.
Water pours into my hollow shell.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀成一堆方块
lines.en: The blast scattered me into blocks.
The arrow sticks in me; no blood.
Magic makes my shape flicker.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的是空壳
lines.en: I do not eat; the shell starves.
Lightning shows exactly what I am.
The void unpicks me into pixels.
